en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings. Pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th century clothing stand along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further up the street. Hanging shop signs include one reading "Wirthschafts Bazar." In the distance, on a hill above the street, a large castle-like complex can be seen. At the bottom in red script is the caption "Meissen. Burgstrasse." and along the left edge is a vertical printer's credit.
